name: Girdhari Lal Bawri
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025)
forbes_bio: Girdharilal Bawri is the chairman of Macleods Pharmaceuticals, one of India's leading pharma firms.
Bawri, whose family owned a pharmacy in Jaipur, set up Macleods Pharmaceuticals in 1986 with his two siblings to make anti-TB medicines.
Macleods produces generics for a range of diseases including asthma, osteoporosis and diabetes.
His younger brother Banwarilal Bawri is joint managing director of Macleods. While his other younger brother Rajendra Agrawal passed away in November 2025.
forbes_facts: Bawri and his two siblings live together with their families in the same building in Mumbai.
The company was named after John Macleod, a Scottish doctor and author of medical textbooks.?

name: Lau Cho Kun
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Lau Cho Kun is the largest shareholder in Hap Seng Consolidated, through holding company Gek Poh and investment arm Lei Shing Hong.
The diversified firm's interests include financial services, plantations and property.
Its plantation division is one of the largest producers of palm oil in Sabah, East Malaysia.
Hap Seng Consolidated has been operating Mercedes-Benz dealerships in Malaysia since 1969.
Privately held Hong Kong-based Lei Shing Hong runs Mercedes-Benz dealerships in Asia and Europe.
forbes_facts: Yaw Chee Ming, CEO of Samling Strategic, a fellow rich lister, is his son-in-law.
Lau is the nephew of Lau Gek Poh, the late founder of Gek Poh Holdings.

name: Peter Kelly
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: Peter Kelly founded IT infrastructure provider Softcat in 1993, spending a reported $44,400 and working out of his garden shed.
Kelly, a college dropout, started out in sales at Xerox Corp.
He took Softcat public in 2015 on the London Stock Exchange and owns just over 30% of the company.
Kelly is known to offer his staff free breakfast and a weekly shirt-ironing service.

name: Larry Fink
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Larry Fink is cofounder, chairman and CEO of powerhouse investment management firm BlackRock, one of the world's largest asset managers.
He and seven partners founded BlackRock in 1988. Originally it was part of The Blackstone Group.
BlackRock was spun off from Blackstone in 1994 and went public in 1999.
Today Blackrock has $14 trillion in assets under management.
Before starting BlackRock, Fink was a managing director at The First Boston Corporation.

name: Bahari Karim
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2019-2026)
forbes_bio: Bahari Karim or Lim Ek Tie is a director of Musim Mas Holdings, a Singapore-based integrated palm oil firm that owns operations in Indonesia.
He runs Musim Mas alongisde brothers Bachtiar and Burhan.
His late father Anwar founded Nam Cheong Soap Factory in 1932; the family-run operation still makes soaps and margarine.
The family opened the first palm oil refinery in Indonesia in 1970. Musim Mas was formally set up two years later.

name: Miguel Tomás Arrufat Pujol
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Miguel Tomás Arrufat Pujol founded Spanish online education group Proeduca Altus, which provides accredited university courses online across Spain, Latin America, and the U.S.
Arrufat Pujol, who has led Proeduca Altus since its creation in 2007, owns more than 75% of the company, which went public in 2019.
Arrufat Pujol will sell around a third of his stake in Proeduca Altus for more than $300 million as part of a take private deal that is expected to close in the second quarter of 2025.
Arrufat Pujol was previously the CEO of a Spanish publishing house that focused on educational textbooks before founding Proeduca Altus.

name: Eduardo Costantini
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2017-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: After working as a stockbroker and finance executive, Eduardo Costantini founded real estate development firm Consultatio S.A. in 1991.
The Buenos Aires-traded firm has developments in Argentina and the U.S., including a $700 million luxury residential complex near Miami.
He owns nearly 70% of Consultatio S.A., his largest asset.
He's also a majority shareholder of Consultatio Asset Management, a Buenos Aires firm with over $700 million of assets under of management.
forbes_facts: Costantini's foundation supports the Latin American Art Museum of Buenos Aires, known as MALBA, which features part of his art collection.

name: Zhang Xin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2006-2026); Hurun Self-Made Women (2017-2025)
forbes_bio: Zhang Xin and her husband Pan Shiyi co-founded real estate developer Soho China.
Soho China is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and develops office towers in Shanghai and Beijing.
Prior to founding Soho China, Zhang worked on Wall Street for Goldman Sachs and Travelers Group.
In June 2021, U.S. private equity giant Blackstone said it would buy the majority of Soho China for as much as $3.05 billion; the purchase wasn't completed.
In 2022, Pan and Zhang stepped down from their leadership roles as chairman and CEO "in order to focus on supporting the arts and philanthropic pursuits" but remain on the board.
